approach: Discrete three-state band-edge policy. The first trade in a timestamp is classified against an inferred fair-price band; later trades are retail. Arb buying X produces low bid/high ask; arb selling X reverses them. Retail is symmetric. Fees decay linearly with steps since the state changed. Seven slots, no history loops or external calls.

frozen_source.selection_rule: largest mean on seeds 0..1999; source fixed before fresh evaluation

next: At the selected base fee, independently ablate low fee, high fee and decay to separate useful state response from the symmetric fee level.
Instrument training simulations to measure the arb/retail confusion matrix, then tune independent pre-trade and post-trade band tolerances without changing fee levels.
Compare the state machine against the network incumbent on fresh paired seeds; retain or simplify it only if its incremental gain clears two standard errors.
